text:
nina-peopleops: Urgent FYI  spotted a handful of candidate invites (bulk import) that include an internal-only prep PDF link in the invite body. That link requires login but still shouldn't be in candidate emails.

alex-recruiting: How many? any evidence it was sent to candidates?

nina-peopleops: Looks like 9 candidate emails went out in the last 2 hours. The prep link is internal, prefixed with `https://internal.redwood.com/.../prep-packet.pdf`. Candidates probably can't open it without creds but we need to strip all internal links from candidate-facing messages.

omar-eng: Can you paste a sanitized webhook payload from the bulk export that included the link?

nina-peopleops: sample payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "candidate_id": "C-5021",
  "interview_id": "I-5021-01",
  "invite_body": "Join the interview. Prep: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/prep-packet/123",
  "attachments": [
    {"type": "pdf", "url": "https://internal.redwood.com/docs/prep-packet/123", "audience": "internal"}
  ],
  "audience_override": null
}
```

marco-scheduler: scheduler logic currently appends `attachments` regardless of `audience` and uses `invite_body` verbatim. The mapping job used to strip attachments with `audience==internal` but a recent change removed that guard. There is also a new `audience_override` field introduced by ATS which is null here.

lina-peopleops: This is a P1 for candidate-facing privacy. Action plan: (1) stop-gap: scheduler patch to sanitize invite bodies and remove attachments when recipient is `candidate` (hotfix), (2) backfill: update the 9 invites to remove the internal link and replace with candidate-safe shortlink to public guide, (3) rotate the internal prep-packet link and audit access logs to confirm no external access.

secbot: [sec-audit] 2026-06-20T09:12:00Z ALERT potential_data_exposure event_count=9 artifact=internal-prep-packet-123

omar-eng: I'll prepare the hotfix to sanitize bodies and strip attachments for candidate recipients. Will push to prod with a small rollout and include a feature-flag. ETA 30m.

alex-recruiting: I'll compile the list of affected interview IDs and candidate emails and prep the candidate-safe links we want to substitute (docs.redwood.com/public/interviewer-guides/backend). We should also update invite templates to never include `internal` attachments.

lina-peopleops: For backfill, prefer PATCHing invites to remove the internal link and add a short candidate-safe line: "Prep materials are here: https://docs.redwood.com/interviewer-guides/{role}". Also add an audit note on the interview stating the internal link was removed.

marco-scheduler: Hotfix deployed to prod (feature-flag=true). Sanitization rule: remove attachments where `audience==internal` OR urls matching `*.internal.redwood.com`. Also scrub `invite_body` by regex for internal hostnames.

omar-eng: Running backfill script against the 9 invites now. It will: PATCH invite body, remove attachments array, add audit tag `internal-attachment-removal-20260620` and create a ticket to rotate the internal doc. Dry-run indicated 9 patches.

secbot: [sec-audit] 2026-06-20T09:42:00Z INFO backfill_started user=omar-eng job=remove-internal-attachments count=9

marco-scheduler: Backfill completed. All 9 invites patched. Audit tag added.

secbot: [sec-audit] 2026-06-20T09:48:20Z INFO access_logs_checked last_24h external_access_attempts=0

lina-peopleops: Thanks. Next steps: (1) recruit team to double-check candidate messages for any other internal link patterns, (2) add a unit test to mapping lambda to validate `attachments[*].audience` handling and `invite_body` scrubbing, (3) add monitor that alerts when any invite contains `internal.redwood.com` in the body or attachments.

omar-eng: Adding unit test and monitor. I'll also add a CI lint rule to flag `internal.redwood.com` in template diffs.

alex-recruiting: Noted. I'll send a quick note to the candidates that had invites corrected saying we replaced an internal link with the correct public guide (candidate-safe language). Templated message: "Hi {candidate}, we updated your interview invite to include the correct prep resources."

nina-peopleops: Closing loop  hotfix + backfill done, sec audit OK, monitors + tests queued. Thanks all.

alex-recruiting: Thanks team :thumbsup:
